paper_title: Knowing You Don't Know Learning When to Continue Search in Multi-round   RAG through Self-Practicing
caption: Ablation study on different Inner Monologue turns on HotPotQA. The green line represents the Naive Generation baseline, while the blue line shows the performance of SIM-RAGlite. The red line indicates the EM score using the ground-truth label as an Oracle Critic.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the evolution of the Error Metric (EM) score as a function of the number of “Turns of Inner Monologue” during the evaluation process. The x-axis is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 1, and the units are “Turns of Inner Monologue”. The y-axis is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 50, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 10, and the units are represented as a percentage (%). The first line, represented by red ‘x’ markers, depicts the SIM-RAG (Oracle Critic) model, starting at approximately 15% at Turn 0 and increasing to approximately 45% at Turn 5.  A second line, represented by blue ‘x’ markers, shows the SIM-RAG (lite) model, which begins at approximately 12% at Turn 0 and reaches approximately 25% at Turn 5. A third line, represented by cyan ‘x’ markers, illustrates the Naive Generation baseline, starting at approximately 18% at Turn 0 and reaching approximately 28% at Turn 5.
